Projects.name: Kikoff
Projects.desription: Building a new vendor integration for identity-verification onboarding workflows serving more than 250,000 users each month to reduce operating costs and enable an expected $5M in annual recurring revenue. Collaborating with vendor engineers, Compliance, and Product Ops on verification requirements and the customer experience. Alongside the integration, took ownership of issues uncovered in the codebase: resolved an onboarding bug affecting approximately 3,700 users and halved operator time for credit-reporting uploads through asynchronous, concurrent Sidekiq processing and clearer status displays.

caseStudy.title: Scaling identity verification, reducing operational friction
caseStudy.problem: Reduce operating costs for identity-verification onboarding workflows serving more than 250,000 users each month, while maintaining a smooth customer experience and appropriate risk checks. The new identity-verification vendor integration is expected to enable $5M in annual recurring revenue.
caseStudy.contribution: My primary focus is building the new vendor integration into the identity-verification backend. As I worked through the codebase, I also took ownership of issues I uncovered: finding and resolving an onboarding bug affecting approximately 3,700 users, and redesigning credit-reporting upload processing and status displays.
caseStudy.decision: For the vendor integration, worked with vendor engineers and Compliance on multi-stage verification requirements, using shadow runs, Snowflake analysis, and A/B testing to validate the integration before broader rollout. For credit-reporting uploads, moved post-upload processing to asynchronous, concurrent Sidekiq jobs and made status and results clear in the UI.
caseStudy.result: The vendor integration targets lower operating costs and an expected $5M in annual recurring revenue. Separately, the onboarding bug fix enabled affected applicants to complete additional identity checks, and the credit-reporting redesign halved operator time spent on uploads.
caseStudy.collaboration: Worked with external vendor engineers on integration requirements and with Compliance on multi-stage verification logic. Partnered with Product Ops on the customer experience.

Projects.name: QuickFi
Projects.desription: Built an analytics platform for commercial equipment financing using React, FastAPI, and Supabase. A Python/pandas ETL pipeline processes CSV transaction logs into stage-duration statistics, monthly counts, and per-stage lender outlier flags. An OpenAI tool-calling agent resolves lender/dealer scope and retrieves metrics through predefined read-only query functions, returning plain-language answers, tables, and charts. Reduced transaction bottleneck detection time by 80% across a project analyzing 1K+ transactions.

caseStudy.title: Turning financing workflows into answers
caseStudy.problem: Internal teams needed to understand where equipment-financing deals slowed down, from credit decisions and contract signing to vendor payment. Finding bottlenecks and comparing lenders or dealers required manual analysis of transaction logs.
caseStudy.contribution: Built a React analytics interface and FastAPI backend with CSV ingestion, scope filters, dashboard KPIs, and conversational queries. Developed a Python/pandas ETL pipeline for 1K+ transactions, computing stage durations, summary statistics, monthly counts, and outlier flags in Supabase. Integrated an OpenAI agent that resolves lender/dealer names and calls predefined query tools to return answers, tables, or charts.
caseStudy.decision: Separated ETL writes from the agent’s read-only query layer. Stage calculations and outlier detection run in Python before questions are asked; the model receives scope and entity context, then retrieves the relevant metrics through function calling. Outliers are evaluated per stage and lender using an IQR threshold, with at least four observations and nonzero IQR.
caseStudy.result: Reduced transaction bottleneck detection time by 80%, helping teams investigate cycle times and performance outliers through plain-language questions.
caseStudy.collaboration: Delivered a freelance tool that helped teams investigate financing workflows through questions in plain language.

Projects.name: Data Validation System
Projects.desription: Built and deployed a scalable, automated post-processing validation system using AWS Glue with Apache Spark, EventBridge, and CDK, processing 15K+ daily records in production workflows serving 1M+ customers. Developed schema enforcement, null detection, and field-specific validation rules, reducing debugging time by 20%+ through early error detection. Reduced data quality-related on-call tickets by 25%, improving pipeline reliability for 3+ downstream teams.

caseStudy.title: Catching data-quality issues earlier
caseStudy.problem: Production data workflows serving 1M+ customers needed stronger quality checks and earlier detection of invalid records.
caseStudy.contribution: Built and deployed automated post-processing validation for 15K+ daily records using AWS Glue, Apache Spark, EventBridge, and CDK.
caseStudy.decision: Made schema enforcement, null detection, and field-specific rules explicit in the validation layer, bringing errors to light earlier in the workflow.
caseStudy.result: Reduced debugging time by 20%+ and data-quality on-call tickets by 25%, improving reliability for 3+ downstream teams.
caseStudy.collaboration: Built validation that supported the reliability needs of multiple downstream teams.

Projects.name: Industrial Technology Research Institute
Projects.desription: Built a local RAG chatbot pipeline using pdfplumber for PDF extraction, SentenceTransformer embeddings, a FAISS vector store of 30K+ vectors, Llama3, LangChain, and Streamlit. Crawled and preprocessed 900+ disease-related documents from web and PDF sources, integrating a document retriever and LLM re-ranker to improve answer accuracy by 50%. Evaluated chatbot accuracy using hospital-sourced workflows to improve reliability and contextual accuracy.
Projects.summary: A local healthcare RAG pipeline with 30K+ vectors; document retrieval and re-ranking improved answer accuracy by 50%.

Projects.name: SmartPantry
Projects.desription: During a 36-hour hackathon, my team developed SmartPantry, a mobile application aimed at reducing food waste by helping users manage their groceries more efficiently. Built using Expo React Native and Appwrite, the app allows users to track their ingredients, receive expiration reminders, and get recipe suggestions based on what they have on hand. SmartPantry empowers users to minimize waste and make meal planning easier, aligning with our mission to address the global issue of food waste.
Projects.summary: A hackathon mobile app for grocery tracking, expiration reminders, and recipe suggestions.

Built a modern, multi-page responsive site using Next.js to better communicate the company's mission and showcase their technology to decision-makers in healthcare and commercial environments.

Projects.name: RAG System with Local LLM
Projects.desription: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that allows users to upload and analyze unlimited documents using a locally hosted LLM (Llama3). The system enables efficient document retrieval and context-aware chatbot responses, leveraging FAISS for vector storage and LangChain for seamless integration.
Projects.summary: Local document retrieval and context-aware answers with FAISS, LangChain, and Llama3.

Projects.name: AguaClara

I designed a scalable content management system (CMS) using JavaScript and JSON to manage data for over 60 team members. I also authored detailed technical documentation and oversaw the deployment and maintenance of the site, setting up continuous integration to streamline updates and ensure efficient maintenance. 
 In my current role as a Backend Developer on the POST subteam, I am working on the integration of  AWS Amplify to enable real-time and offline data synchronization for the backend of AguaDatos, ensuring data reliability in areas with limited network access.

Projects.name: Glimpse
Projects.desription: Glimpse is a website/app designed to make it easy for friends to stay connected and updated on each other's lives. By signing up with your friend group, you will receive a monthly email with prompts about your lives. Simply respond to the prompts and share any photos or videos you like. Friends can log into their accounts to view their memories over time and customize prompts.
Projects.summary: A shared space for friend groups to collect monthly updates, photos, and memories.
